description: This file defines the SpeedPickerActivity class for an Android wearable application. It presents a list of speed options to the user, allowing them to select a speed limit, and communicates the selected speed via an Intent result.

classes.name: SpeedPickerActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a list of speed options for the user to select from; it implements click handling and communicates the selection back via an Intent.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures the list view with an adapter, and attaches scroll and click listeners.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on list items, retrieves the selected speed, and returns it as a result.

methods.name: onTopEmptyRegionClick
methods.description: Empty override; handles clicks on empty regions, but currently does nothing.
